votes.motion: Approve the work session and formal meeting minutes of October 15, 2024 and November 12, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from its October 15, 2024 and November 12, 2024 work session and formal meetings.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 and B-2 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing for the EPA Brownfields Grant and My Brothers Keeper Accelerator Communities Cohort Grant applications and referred both items to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 01 of 2025, amending the zoning map for a portion of the property located at approximately 333 West 700 South.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning the CG (General Commercial) portion of the split-zoned property at 333 West 700 South to D-2 (Downtown Support), unifying the parcel under a single zoning designation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 02 of 2025, amending the zoning of the properties at approximately 238 South Concord Street and 1255 West Pierpont Avenue from R-1/5,000 to RMF-30.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning two properties from Single-Family Residential (R-1/5,000) to Low-Density Multi-Family Residential (RMF-30) to allow construction of five to seven family-sized units.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 03 of 2025 (Northpoint Light Industrial Zoning Text Amendment).
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance creating a new Northpoint Light Industrial (M-1A) Zoning District under Title 21A, aligning with the Northpoint Small Area Plan to support light industrial, office, and research uses while reducing impacts on adjacent properties and habitats.

votes.motion: Ratify the election of Council Member Wharton as Chair and Council Member Puy as Vice Chair for 2025.
votes.description: The Council formally ratified the election of its Chair and Vice Chair for calendar year 2025.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of David Buchanan as the Chief Human Resources Officer for Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council approved the Mayor's appointment of David Buchanan to serve as the City's Chief Human Resources Officer.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Tammy Hunsaker as the Director of the Community and Neighborhoods Department for Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council approved the Mayor's appointment of Tammy Hunsaker to serve as Director of the Community and Neighborhoods Department.

votes.motion: Pass a legislative action initiating a zoning petition for City Staff to research and draft an ordinance updating Salt Lake City Code pertaining to fence and hedge heights, increasing maximum hedge height to 6 feet in front/side yards and maximum fence/wall/hedge height behind the primary facade to 7 feet.
votes.description: The Council passed a legislative action directing staff to draft a zoning ordinance amendment that would raise the allowed hedge height along side yards in front of the primary structure to 6 feet and the maximum fence, wall, or hedge height behind the primary facade to 7 feet.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 04 of 2025, amending chapters 2.46 and 2.68 of Salt Lake City Code relating to campaign finance disclosures and city elections.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance updating campaign finance disclosure rules, removing PAC/PIC reporting components, adjusting contribution limit references, and making other housekeeping changes to align with state code requirements.

The Council adopted an ordinance amending City Code 2.06.070 to provide annual leadership stipends to the Chair and Vice Chair of both the City Council and the Redevelopment Agency, without changing base Council pay.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting a public hearing date for the Library Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2024-25 and approving several board appointments and reappointments to the Accessibility and Disability Commission, Art Design Board, and Racial Equity in Policing Commission.
